scope: Future RTL scoreboard oracle binding only; Python references are event-level golden semantics, not RTL, SVA, timing, or PPA evidence.

bindings.observe: R5 descriptor and payload requests share R2 then R1; durable is not publication
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not create a descriptor bypass or native-HBM command model

bindings.observe: R1 durable + P3 complete + staged M2 + descriptor visibility nest in one commit
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not split into independently visible commits
do not model a cycle or advance on valid alone

bindings.observe: quiescence and durable invalidation precede generation/bitmap reuse
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not treat raw HBM bytes as post-reset reachable

bindings.observe: one outward fault only after four commits
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not turn numeric_fault into retry or fallback

bindings.observe: old epoch responses reject without mutation
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not assume reset erases HBM

bindings.observe: all named R6 drain acknowledgements precede ack
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not replace drain predicate with timeout

bindings.observe: one hot/pending/packed authority; transient P3/S2/direct excluded
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not count transient copies as authority

bindings.observe: oldest eligible ordinal and credit conservation
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not change frozen class order

bindings.observe: release only after four commits/current generation
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not use payload read as consumer completion

bindings.observe: stale old identity cannot mutate reused S2/direct association
one ok/fault terminal and no Full-KV dispatch
finite fair event sequence reaches terminal
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not interpret event count as latency

bindings.observe: finite fair drain sequence reaches matching ack
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not infer a timeout or service guarantee

bindings.observe: terminal publication/fault path returns logical credit
bindings.forbidden_adapter: do not interpret logical credit capacity as physical FIFO depth
